items.title: Senior Analyst - Risk Data Intelligence, Fintech
items.salary: Base: $140,500 - $190,000; Bonus/Equity: Eligible; Benefits: Competitive package with pay-for-performance rewards
keyRequirements: 3+ years of experience in analytics or data science

The role supports a growing analytics culture within Intuit’s Global Solutions Business Group, enabling strategic decisions across finance, product, compliance, and marketing.
